## Problem and change

Explain the user problem, affected files and smallest useful fix.

## Evidence

- [ ] Regression coverage uses disposable repositories where appropriate.
- [ ] Exact check commands and outcomes are listed, including skipped checks.
- [ ] Help, examples and safety limitations match behavior.
- [ ] Logs and visual assets contain no secrets or private history.

## Git safety and compatibility

List reference, HEAD, index, working-tree, remote and operation-state effects.
Explain preview/opt-in behavior, failure cases and compatibility risks.
Do not describe work as recoverable without implementation evidence.
